terra.problem: “Wrong shift” says the baker’s answer was wrong.
The text does not say whether the servant is on the clock at the gate.
The text does not say nobody called the field crew to the meeting.
The text does not say Boaz gathered the elders so they could see what happened.
Saying Boaz is polite enough to go second assigns him a reason the text does not give.
The text does not say the man answered without a pause or spoke fast.
The text does not say how quickly the man answered.
“A minute earlier” and “flipped fast” add timing the text does not give.
The passage does not say that people in former times had no pens.
The text does not say Boaz wanted the crowd to hear every name.
“Wrong branch” says the baker’s answer was wrong.
The crowd wishes that Boaz’s house may become like Perez’s house; it does not say it will. Nor does the text say they ask for children.
“That’s the word they use” follows “children,” but the crowd’s word is “offspring.”
The explanation turns the crowd’s wish that Boaz’s house may become like Perez’s into a statement that it will.
The crowd wishes that Boaz’s house may become like Perez’s because of the offspring the LORD will give; the text does not say they asked for offspring.
The reference to Naomi’s earlier hard words needs a reference to the earlier passage.
The women do not say that Naomi will be sustained where she currently lives.
The text calls the speakers women, but does not identify them as the neighbor women named later. Ruth 1:16 also does not establish that Ruth followed Naomi home.
“Wrong spot” says the baker’s answer was wrong.
The cited verse supports Samuel’s anointing of David but does not identify Samuel as a prophet.
